task.description: Hard gate: review DDL-02/ORD-01/ORD-02/ORD-04 against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md. New tables (plat_effect_completion, plat_correlation_cursor) and new consumer/locking logic (src/ordering/). Check: SQL parameterization on all new queries (especially the FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claim and the advisory-lock hashtext expression -- confirm correlation_id is never string-interpolated into the hashtext() call), no catch unreachable on realistic DB/lock-contention failure paths, whether plat_effect_completion/plat_correlation_cursor need tenant-scoping (is this a cross-tenant platform-level table like platform.platform_migrations, or does it need per-tenant isolation -- read the requirement bodies' framing carefully), and whether the consumer/worker code has any capability-gating concerns (does it run with elevated/platform-level DB access, and is that appropriate given it processes completions across potentially all tenants).
acceptance_criteria: Every numbered security invariant checked against the diff
SQL parameterization verified including the advisory-lock hashtext() call
Tenant-scoping requirement for the two new tables explicitly assessed
Consumer/worker DB access level assessed for appropriateness

result.summary: Security review of commit 75d51091 (DDL-02, ORD-01, ORD-02, ORD-04): INV-1 APPLIES/PASS -- new tables plat_effect_completion/plat_correlation_cursor (migrations 1145/1146) are unqualified CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS with no GBL- prefix and no scope header, so migrations.zig's migrationScope() classifies them as .all_schemas (applied in the public pass AND every per-tenant pass via search_path) -- this matches the process doc's explicit 'Scope: System-wide (effect completion re-entry in every tenant schema)' and DDL-05's design framing that plat_-prefixed objects are platform-owned but live inside each tenant schema, not as a single cross-tenant control table like platform.platform_migrations. Ran lint_migration_schema.py (0 violations, 127 files) and lint_sql_table_refs.py (0 violations, 382 files) -- both clean. No cross-tenant collision risk: correlation_id/completion_id values are per-schema-instance since the tables themselves are per-schema copies. INV-3 NOT APPLICABLE -- no src/lua/host_api or src/wasm/host_api files touched. INV-4 NOT APPLICABLE -- no secret/password/token material in any new file (grepped src/ordering/*.zig and ddl_validate.zig). INV-5 NOT APPLICABLE -- no lookup-by-ID HTTP handler added; consumer.zig/cursor.zig are internal polling/DB modules, not API routes. INV-7 APPLIES/PASS -- verified cursor.zig's tryExecuteGuard issues 'SELECT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext($1)::bigint)' with correlation_id bound as $1, never string-interpolated; ran lint_sql_param_types.py src tests (0 BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR) and the allocPrint-into-SQL heuristic grep (0 hits) across all new files. observability.zig's computeCorrelationLag binds threshold/gap values as $1/$2 text params, not interpolated into the query. INV-8 APPLIES/PASS -- grepped the diff and all new files directly for 'catch unreachable': zero hits; every DB/lock failure path in cursor.zig, consumer.zig, observability.zig returns a typed OrderingError via 'catch return error.X', matching effects/queue.zig's precedent. Ran zig build test-ordering and zig build test-ddl-validate: both exit 0. INV-2 NOT APPLICABLE -- no API response struct added or changed by this commit (the src/api/routes/platform_migrations.zig diff visible in git diff main...HEAD belongs to the already-merged prior batch e526a202/PR-708, not to 75d51091). Consumer/worker DB access level (task-specific check 4): src/ordering/consumer.zig's runOneCycle acquires connections via the same generic pool.acquire()/*db.Pool type every other module uses -- no elevated/platform-only credential, no raw psql/bypass connection. pool.zig's applyRequestStorageRouting() routes search_path from tenant_context exactly as it does for src/effects/worker.zig's reenterEffectResult/sweepOnce (which likewise never sets tenant_context explicitly and defaults to public); this is the existing, accepted pattern for system-wide background workers on this platform, not a new escalation. checkConstrainBeforeExpand in ddl_validate.zig is a pure, no-DB, no-allocator static predicate (grepped for conn./pool./query(/exec( -- zero matches in the new function), consistent with DDL-05's precedent requiring DDL-01's family of checks to run on parsed statement descriptors before any statement executes. INV-6 satisfied by this review's own completion.
